thread:
Ivy: 90-second challenge: post the funniest one-liner you can think of. Winner gets to pick the snack for Friday.
Marco: My coffee and I are in a committed relationship; we see other people on weekends. :coffee:
Zoe: I tried to organize my bookshelf by mood. It now only contains suspense. :books:
Ravi: My laptop asked for a raise after I closed 20 tabs. I obliged. :money_with_wings:
Ivy: OK those were dangerously short and very good. Quick snack poll: chips (:chip:), fruit bowl (:apple:), or cinnamon rolls (:cinnamon_roll:)? React with emoji.
Marco: :chip: spicy please
Zoe: :cinnamon_roll: sticky fingers mandatory
Ravi: :apple: health flex
SnackAlert: Poll results  chips 1, fruit bowl 1, cinnamon rolls 1. Tiebreaker rule: whoever's desk has the most stickers wins.
Ivy: @Zoe you win (sticker champion). Cinnamon rolls ordered :tada:
Marco: Shoutout to @Ravi for rescuing the office fern last week. It sent a thank-you note in leaf language. :herb:
Zoe: Also shoutout to @Ivy for the lunchtime playlist. My ears are grateful. :headphones:
Ravi: PS someone left a pair of sunglasses in the kitchen labeled "future me." Honestly, same. :sunglasses:
Ivy: Closing thread  one-liner vault appended, snack logistics handled. See you at the pastry lineup Friday :wave:
